title: Clear Skies
ending: Your notes show how careful observation and care can help a Pokemon recover.

stages.description: Investigate an unusual PokeStop and help a Shadow Pokemon.
stages.dialog: Some local stops have unusual visitors. Record what happens, and look closely at the Pokemon left behind.

stages.description: Follow the signals to a Rocket Leader hideout.
stages.dialog: The components seem connected. Keep a record of their signals before following the trail.

stages.description: Complete the investigation and challenge Giovanni.
stages.dialog: A final signal stands apart. Prepare carefully and bring back an accurate account of what you find.
